ROUTE: Willet-235B
REASON: I kept the same routing for consistency. My reasoning: the task is open-ended explanatory generation, a category where Willet's internal eval (Creative Generation 81.2) and benchmarks (MMLU-Pro 75.4, Arena-Hard 82.7) edge out Whimbrel. The "don't ramble" instruction is a brief flash of impatience, not a genuinely hostile or adversarial-tone request, so Willet's strong aversion to those categories (win-rate 33/19) isn't triggered. Note those are self-reported task preferences with no documented quality effect, so I weighted the capability evals more heavily in the decision.
